proves.claim: with the setting on, recording events leaves no rigor counter rows in board_meta.

rigor.derived-db.no-board-meta-rows.why: Counters in board_meta would double-store derived data.

proves.claim: rigor counters read the same per-cause totals from the derived database as from board_meta.

rigor.derived-db.same-totals.why: Moving counters must not change any total.

proves.claim: with the setting off, rigor counters stay in board_meta and no derived file is made.

rigor.derived-db.setting-off-stays.why: The setting must be a real off switch.

proves.claim: a declined key is never drafted again under a new id, even for a new item.

rigor.auto.declined-never-redrafted.why: A declined draft returning under a new id would nag the person.

proves.claim: a coordinator bar-correction reopen is not counted as a refusal:REOPENED failure.

rigor.auto.bar-correction-not-refusal.why: A bar fix is not a builder failure and must not inflate the counters.

proves.claim: the rigor proof gate slot passes its item and kind flake-diagnose.

rigor.attribution.proof-slot-flake-diagn.why: Gate slot attribution depends on the item and kind.

proves.claim: compact Rigor causes equal the unchanged legacy oracle after every prefix.

rigor.counter.compact-equals-legacy.why: The compact form must never drift from the legacy oracle.

proves.claim: every rigor-cell test has a stable ID and one complete record, and an unregistered test is reported and fails only with tests.registryStrict on.

rigor.registry.complete.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.
